subject: general
question: Which of the following institutions is mandated by the Constitution to make recommendations to the President on the principles which should govern the grants-in-aid of the revenues of the States out of the Consolidated Fund of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Finance Commission.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 280 of the Constitution of India **gives that, every five years, the President shall constitute a Finance Commission, which shall advice assistance from the **Consolidated Fund of India.**
 
• So, the Finance commission advice the **principles governing the grants-in-aid of the revenues of the States out of the Consolidated Fund of India.**
 
• The **Fifteenth Finance Commission (XV-FC or 15-FC)** is an Indian Finance Commission constituted in **November 2017** and is to provide suggestions for devolution of taxes and other fiscal matters for five fiscal years, begin **2020-04-01.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Department of Expenditure **do ​regular monitoring of the resources and Ways & Means position of the States as well as their overdrafts. 
 
• **Reserve Bank of India** regulates the monetary policy concerning the national currency, the Indian rupee. 
 
• **A law commission, law** improve commission, or law revision commission is an independent part set up by a **government to conduct law reform.**
